summary.text: John Sjaarda is a Republican state representative from South Dakota House District 2 who is running for South Dakota State Senate District 2 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A farmer and volunteer firefighter, he assumed office in the House in January 2023.

paragraphs.text: John Sjaarda's career experience includes working as a farmer, and he has volunteered as a firefighter with Valley Springs, South Dakota.
Sjaarda assumed office in the South Dakota House of Representatives on January 10, 2023.

In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the House Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and the House Local Government Committee, and in the 2025-2026 session he is assigned to the House Appropriations Committee.
He defeated David Kull in the Republican primary for State Senate District 2 on June 2, 2026.
